message: 機嫌は低気圧な低血圧

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, come on, over here~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, whoa. You don't have to pull me, I can walk on my own!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't walk, please run!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huff, huff... What's gotten into you so early in the morning」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I thought I'd let you in on a super special new discovery, President」

name: Synn
message: 「At the church?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. I'm sure even you don't know about this, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... I've never come to the church in the morning before」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Believe it or not, rumor has it an eerie singing voice can be heard here night after night!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's morning right now」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Shh!! Quiet, please」
I strain my ears to listen, but I don't hear any singing.

name: Lolotte
message: 「How strange... Could it have just been someone's imagination?」

name: Synn
message: 「Singing, huh. When it comes to singing in a church, the choir is the only thing that comes to mind」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The choir!! Now that has a sacred ring to it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「And who was the one calling it eerie just a second ago?」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me, what do you think you're doing」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, a ghost!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Geez! Don't scream all of a sudden!! It's ringing in my head, ugh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa. What are you doing here?」

name: Misa
message: 「Choir practice. Look, the Holy Night Festival is right around the corner」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh~~. The choir... wait, you're in the choir!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Last year's Holy Night Festival. What were you even looking at?」

name: Synn
message: 「Singing is meant to be listened to, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「You always have some smart comeback!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Madam Vice President... you are wonderful...\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed. Why don't you join the choir too, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I would love to!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is what I would like to say, but my hands are completely full with Student Council activities right now」

name: Synn
message: 「That's the same for you too, Misa. Having to do this so early in the morning must be tough」

name: Misa
message: 「Something like this is no trouble at all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I hope to follow Madam Vice President's example and develop low blood pressure myself」

name: Misa
message: 「What kind of lesson are you taking from this?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, you say practice... I didn't hear anything though?」

name: Misa
message: 「It finished ages ago. We're just cleaning up now」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Being a low-ranking member means having so much to do, it must be hard~」

name: Misa
message: 「I am the leader, after all. It can't be helped」

name: Synn
message: 「Our conversation isn't really lining up here, but you're the leader of the choir, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, that's right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, that is another surprise」

name: Misa
message: 「The welcoming ceremony at the entrance ceremony. What were you even looking at?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Singing is meant to be listened to, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm already sick of hearing that line!!」
